name: blind_construction_eval
method: Questions written WITHOUT sight of the construction KB entries. The author knew only the domain distribution (roads, buildings, procurement, concrete) and the three procurement workflow ids surfaced by earlier tests; no question targets those workflows. Scoring: a question is a hit when a single entry among the top-k contains every expected keyword in its title+statement (strict AND).

questions.question: What is the minimum concrete cover to reinforcement for foundations cast against the ground?
What is the maximum water-cement ratio for durable structural concrete?
What is the maximum longitudinal gradient allowed for a main road?
What compaction percentage is required for road subbase layers?
How long must structural concrete be cured before loading?
What is the minimum laying temperature for asphalt paving?
What is the maximum spacing of control joints in concrete slabs?
What lap length is required for reinforcement bar splices?
At what excavation depth is shoring or a retaining structure required?
What minimum cover depth is required for drainage pipes under roads?
What slump range is acceptable for pumped concrete?
What pavement layer thickness is required for heavy traffic roads?
